 Weather Video 
 Sunny conditions stick around until the weekend
 By Sara McCoy 
 today at 3:25 PM 
 Published 
 November 11, 2026 
 11:26 AM 
 Today: The 60-degree weather keeps on coming. Today we're tracking a high of 62 for Colorado Springs. A bit of a breeze pops up after noon but outdoor conditions stay pleasant. 
 Tomorrow: The morning will still be chilly but above freezing dropping down to 36 degrees from 6-7 am. Thursday brings even warmer weather as the ridge of high pressure builds in over Colorado. The Springs will likely hit a high temperature of 65 degrees and 68 degrees in Pueblo.
 Friday: A few clouds get in the mix but highs stay warm for a nice Friday. Conditions change heading into the weekend as we track afternoon showers for Saturday marking an end to the dry quiet weather. 
 Article Topic Follows: Weather Video

 Sara McCoy
 Sara studied Journalism and Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences at the University of Colorado, Boulder. She is currently a graduate student in Meteorology at Mississippi State, where she has worked on research studying how to mitigate avalanche fatalities in the Rocky Mountains.
